summary: Composites Input 1 only where Input 2 is not fully opaque, effectively the opposite alpha-mask relationship of Inside TOP.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed layer that defines final resolution/aspect: input1 or input2.

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Fit behavior for the overlay before compositing.

key_params.name: justifyh
key_params.note: Horizontal placement of the overlay layer.

key_params.name: justifyv
key_params.note: Vertical placement of the overlay layer.

common_gotchas: Requires meaningful alpha in Input 2; opaque masks hide Input 1 entirely.
Fixed Layer chooses final dimensions but does not change the Input 1/Input 2 compositing relationship.
Pre-fit and transform controls operate on the non-fixed overlay input.
Use Native Resolution prefit when pixel-accurate overlay alignment matters.
3D textures and 2D texture arrays should keep depth and array size consistent downstream.
key_concepts: Composites Input 1 only where Input 2 alpha is less than fully opaque.
Acts as the opposite alpha-mask relationship of Inside TOP.
Supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays in addition to 2D textures.
Fixed Layer controls the final resolution/aspect while transform parameters affect the overlay layer.
